metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear I shot the floor and Valorant said ‘Congrats, you’re a legend’
metadata.description:
Wait, did that even register?
Enemy probably questioning reality.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game still hands out freebies.
Valorant logic making no sense again.

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!
